stories.title: Racepaard met naam die naar Hitler verwijst krijgt andere naam

en.title: Racehorse with name referencing Hitler gets new name
en.summary: The owner of a racehorse named Austrian Painter in the United States was required to rename the animal because the name is used online as a synonym for Adolf Hitler.

stories.title: Verdachte dubbele moord op Syriërs zegt ontoerekeningsvatbaar te zijn verklaard

en.title: Suspect in double murder of Syrians claims to be found unaccountable
en.summary: A man accused of killing two Syrian boys states he has been declared fully unaccountable by experts at the Pieter Baan Center, according to his lawyer.

stories.title: Verdachte moord op Syrische tieners verklaart zichzelf ontoerekeningsvatbaar

en.title: Suspect in murder of Syrian teenagers declares himself unaccountable
en.summary: The 25-year-old suspect in the shooting deaths of two Syrian teenagers on January 1st in Amsterdam largely exercises his right to remain silent and claims he is unaccountable, expecting psychiatric treatment rather than imprisonment.

stories.title: Man overleden die werd geraakt bij aanslag op Trump in 2024

en.title: Man injured in 2024 attack on Trump dies
en.summary: James Copenhaver, one of three men wounded in the failed assassination attempt on President Trump in 2024, has died at age 76 after suffering lasting injuries from being shot in the arm and abdomen.

stories.title: Susan Sarandon en Hannah Einbinder aangehouden bij protest tegen Netanyahu

en.title: Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder arrested at protest against Netanyahu
en.summary: Actresses Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder were detained in New York during a demonstration against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's visit to the United Nations, along with comedian Caleb Hearon.

stories.title: Jetten neemt het op voor Strafhof na kritiek Trump: 'Handen ervan af'

en.title: Jetten defends International Criminal Court after Trump criticism: 'Hands off'
en.summary: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten defended the International Criminal Court in his UN General Assembly speech, responding indirectly to recent statements by Donald Trump without naming him.

stories.title: Handen af van Internationaal Strafhof, waarschuwt Jetten bij VN

en.title: Hands off International Criminal Court, Jetten warns at UN
en.summary: Premier Jetten criticized American President Trump's rhetoric about the International Criminal Court during a UN General Assembly speech, calling for protection of international institutions without naming Trump directly.

stories.title: Na halve spijtbetuigingen buigt minister Van Weel uiteindelijk diep genoeg voor de Tweede Kamer: ‘Het was echt op het randje’

en.title: After partial apologies, Minister Van Weel ultimately apologizes sufficiently to Parliament: 'It was really on the edge'
en.summary: During a lengthy emergency debate on unprocessed crime reports, Justice Minister David van Weel faced opposition criticism for offering procedural apologies, though Parliament ultimately rejected a motion of no confidence against him.

stories.title: ‘Handen af van het Internationaal Strafhof’, zegt Jetten bij VN

en.title: 'Hands off the International Criminal Court', says Jetten at UN
en.summary: Prime Minister Rob Jetten advocated for the International Criminal Court during the UN General Assembly meeting in New York, emphasizing its importance.

stories.title: Premier Jetten in toespraak voor VN: ‘Ondermijning Internationaal Strafhof raakt ons allemaal’

en.title: Premier Jetten in UN speech: 'Undermining International Criminal Court affects us all'
en.summary: The Dutch Premier addressed the United Nations, discussing concerns about undermining the International Criminal Court and its broader implications.

stories.title: Oranje en debuterende Xavi spelen gelijk tegen Duitsland na prachtgoal Gakpo

en.title: Orange and debutant Xavi draw with Germany after magnificent goal by Gakpo
en.summary: The Dutch national team drew 1-1 with Germany in its first match under new coach Xavi Hernández, with Cody Gakpo scoring a spectacular equalizer in the final phase despite an impressive overall performance.

stories.title: Van Weel nog dieper door het stof: 'Heb Tweede Kamer op verkeerde been gezet'

en.title: Van Weel further apologizes: 'I misled Parliament'
en.summary: Justice Minister Van Weel admitted to Parliament that he provided incomplete information regarding unprocessed crime reports filed by citizens, apologizing for misleading lawmakers.
